acceptanceCriteria: Reproduce and retain the clean HEAD==BASE observation and actual Git diff exit/output; distinguish empty delta from missing intent and real Git failure.
Document the supported change-start chronology or add a precise bounded refusal for an intentionally unsupported empty range; preserve immutable binding and honest NOT_PRODUCED evidence.
Add a focused regression only if a product/diagnostic change is chosen; verify the normal nonempty daily workflow and do not weaken completion gates.
body: Observed diagnostic/workflow friction, not a confirmed correctness bug. Core1.0.0-rc.1 build163 and Tasks build202 dev20260929.2. In a new clean public integration worktree /private/tmp/corvint-intake391-integration at25971bda1ca1664d8a546d751cb2bb9bbd454daf with HEAD==BASE, the repository mandates make dogfood-change at change start. Using the actual installedPATHbinary via CORVINT_BIN and existing intake intent path (absent at that public baseline), the command reports cem-prepare: git-diff-failed, then cem-map-not-produced/map-unavailable and unavailable OCM. No CEM produced; no source/ref mutation. Direct immutable baseline query and registry/specindex impact succeeded with retained omissions. After the real normalmerge+ownseal reversal, the same supported workflow produces the expected new CEM. Evidence /tmp/containment391-integration-change-start2.log (the baseline JSON report was not archived separately; later workflow overwrote the ignored report path), new CEM log /tmp/containment391-integration-cem-initial.log. A separate first mistaken executable-path version mismatch and an incorrect impact --path invocation were operator mistakes, retained separately and not part of this suspected product friction. Expected: clear documented ordering and an explicit empty-range/unsupported-intent reason if this start is intentionally unsupported, rather than implying native Git execution failed. Dedup agent-memory searches git-diff-failed, empty patch, empty diff, no-op and change start found no matching item; broad dogfood results include V1-0465 qualification work but no explicit empty-start diagnosis. No implementation change in391.
title: Dogfood: clarify change-start behavior for an empty base-to-HEAD range
